common_shapes_comparison.description: Common Shapes dataset comparison: PartUV vs xatlas/Blender (Table 1 from paper)

success_rate.description: Diagnostic fraction of Common Shapes meshes that produce a readable UV OBJ; zero-weighted because both reference methods saturate at 100% on the real train/test run.

avg_charts.description: Headline chart-fragmentation metric averaged across evaluated meshes.

median_charts.description: Robust chart-count summary that reduces sensitivity to one extreme mesh.

angular_distortion.description: Mean conformal preservation score across evaluated meshes.

p05_angular_distortion.description: Lower-tail conformal preservation that catches methods with a few badly warped meshes.

area_distortion.description: Mean chart-level equiareal distortion across evaluated meshes.

p95_area_distortion.description: Ninety-fifth percentile shape-level area distortion, following the paper's tail-risk analysis.
